propositions: On bug close, auto-derive a best-effort caused_by link to a culprit ticket by analyzing git blame of pre-fix state over file_impact, resolving culprit commits via rebar-ticket trailer.
caused_by links are written via graph._links._write_link_event directly to bypass the closed-source guard that blocks links from closed bug tickets.
Auto-derivation links only when a strict majority (>50%) of blamed lines across file_impact files point to a single commit that resolves to a ticket; ambiguous cases return no link.
The --caused-by <id> CLI parameter on rebar transition allows explicit override of auto-derived caused_by links at close time.
Fixing-commit discovery identifies the most recent commit in git log whose message resolves to the bug ticket being closed via rebar-ticket trailer or subject reference.
Library callers via transition() in _lib_writes.py can set caused_by on bug close, not only CLI users.
